decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application submitted numbered HD P201, HD P202, HD E100, HD E101, HD E102 and site plan Received 13/04/2010 and Amended drawings HD P201a, HD P202a, HD E100a Received 09/07/2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the western elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the sidewalls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, single storey part rear extension and rear roof extension to the house.
